guard: the status bar's activity series counts live arrivals into the newest bucket, decays with idle time, and draws bars scaled to its own max
why: A ring that never rolls shows a minute-old burst as current; a bucket that never counts draws a flat floor under live traffic; bars not scaled to the max flatten a quiet mesh into one glyph.
Each mutation is compile-clean and unique in the named file, and the suite imports src directly, so no build is involved.

mutations.name: K1 a live message never reaches the newest bucket
mutations.expectRed: three live messages land in the newest bucket
mutations.cell: three live messages land in the newest bucket

mutations.name: K2 the ring never rolls
mutations.expectRed: an idle 4 s shifts the bucket left and opens an empty newest one
mutations.cell: an idle 4 s shifts the bucket left and opens an empty newest one

mutations.name: K3 bars drawn from raw counts instead of the series' max
mutations.expectRed: ...and a series ten-fold louder draws the same bars
mutations.cell: ...and a series ten-fold louder draws the same bars
